source: Use it if you want normal playing conditions but do not feel ready for just one life.#{normal}#
target: 如果你想要普通的游戏条件、但还没准备好一条命通关，就选择这个模式。#{normal}#

source: Potentially it would go with a sword in the future.
target: 未来可能有把剑和它成套。

source:
#GOLD#Hate#LAST#
Hate represents your inner rage against all that lives and dares face you.
It is replenished by killing creatures and through the application of your talents.
All afflicted talents are based on Hate, and many are more effective at higher levels of hate.
target:
#GOLD#仇恨值#LAST#
仇恨值是你对目标生物的愤怒程度。
杀死生物和使用某些技能都可以积累仇恨。
所有的痛苦系技能都依靠仇恨来发挥力量，对于部分技能，仇恨值越高则越有效。

source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you set foot in sight of the Gates of Morning, with no trace of the portal...
target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经来到了能望见晨曦之门的地方，此间毫无传送门的痕迹……

source:
Enter a protective battle stance allowing you to defend yourself more proficiently while using a shield.
		Increases Armour by %d, Block value by %d, and reduces Block cooldown by 2.
		Increases stun and knockback resistance by %d%%.
		The Armor and Block bonuses increase equally with your Dexterity and Strength.
target:
进入一个保护性的战斗姿态，让你在使用盾牌的同时更熟练地保护自己。
		提升护甲值 %d，格挡值 %d，减少格挡冷却 2 回合。
		提升眩晕和击退抗性 %d%%。
		护甲和格挡值加成受你的敏捷和力量值影响。

source:
Focus charged energy and strike an enemy for %d%% weapon damage as lightning.
		Energy will then discharge from your weapon, doing an extra %0.2f lightning damage and halving their stun/daze/freeze/pin resistance for %d turns.
		If the target is pinned and Charged Shield is sustained, its absorb value will be increased by %0.2f.
		If the target is frozen, the ice will melt in a flash of vapour, knocking back all creatures around it in radius 2.
		The discharge damage will scale with your Mindpower.
target:
聚集电能，以闪电伤害打击敌人，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		随后，能量会从你的武器中释放，额外造成 %0.2f 点闪电伤害，并使其震慑/眩晕/冰冻/定身抗性减半，持续 %d 回合。
		若目标被定身且电能护盾处于持续状态，其吸收值将提高 %0.2f 点。
		若目标被冻结，冰块会在蒸汽中瞬间融化，将其周围半径 2 格内的所有生物击退。
		释放伤害受精神强度加成。

source: Phase shift yourself for %d turns; any damage greater than 10%% of your maximum life will teleport you to an adjacent tile and be reduced by 50%% (can only happen once per turn).
target: 切换你的相位 %d 回合；任何将会对你造成超过你最大生命值 10%% 伤害的攻击会把你传送到一个相邻的格子里，并且这次伤害减少50%%（每回合只能发生一次）。

source: Activate the rune to remove 8 beneficial magical sustains from an enemy target or all magical debuffs from you.
target: 激活这个符文，从敌人身上移除 8 个正面魔法持续技能，或从自己身上移除所有魔法负面效果。

source: The target is blinded, unable to see anything.
target: 目标被致盲，什么都看不见。

source:
#{bold}#
Gamrik Dellhorn
#{normal}#47 - 93#{italic}#
Fell to the Wintertide blizzard
#{normal}#
target:
#{bold}#
加米里克·戴尔亨
#{normal}#47 - 93#{italic}#
死于霜华时节的暴风雪
#{normal}#

deep_observation: 补查：组件 mod-tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/zones/shertul-fortress-caldizar/zone.lua:74（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63），调用 Dialog:simpleLongPopup 的弹窗正文，原文与冻结 source 逐字一致。两处语义偏差：(1) "a gentle humming noise in the background" 指环境背景中的低鸣，译文作「背后传来轻柔的嗡嗡声」把非方位的 background 读成方位「背后」，与同段紧接的 "From ahead you sense something"（译文「在你的前方」）构成本不存在的前/后方位对照，误导玩家以为声源在身后；应作「背景中传来」之类。(2) "gentle lighting" 是柔和的灯光，译文作「温暖的灯光」把 gentle（柔和）替换为 warm（温暖），与同句 "smooth walls"（光滑墙壁）并列的质感描写不符。
source: With a sudden jolt you find yourself... somewhere familiar. The smooth walls and gentle lighting remind you of your fortress. And yet it feels different too. There is a gentle humming noise in the background, and your whole body feels light, almost weightless, such that the slightest movement propels you into the air. You have the odd feeling that you are not on Maj'Eyal any longer... From ahead you sense something both terrible and wonderful, and trepidation fills every corner of your being.
surface_observation: 原文“remind you of your fortress”表示让你想起自己的堡垒，译文“提醒你这是你的堡垒”误成确认当前地点就是自己的堡垒；“in the background”表示背景中的声音，译成“背后传来”添加了原文没有的方位。
target: 随着突然的震动，你发现自己身处某个熟悉的地方。那光滑的墙壁和温暖的灯光提醒你这是你的堡垒。不过它仍然有所不同。背后传来轻柔的嗡嗡声，你感觉整个身体轻飘飘的，几乎像羽毛一样，似乎你轻轻的移动都能跃至半空。你有着一种奇异的感觉——你似乎不在马基·埃亚尔了……在你的前方你感到了某种既可怕又美妙的东西，恐惧充满了你身心的每个角落。
来自另一条时间线的生物。

source:
You have learned to sing the praises of the Moons, in the form of three defensive Hymns:

Hymn of Shadows: Increases your movement speed by %d%% and your spell casting speed by %d%%.

Hymn of Detection: Increases your ability to see stealthy creatures by %d and invisible creatures by %d, and increases your critical power by %d%%.

Hymn of Perseverance: Increases your resistance to stun, confusion and blinding by %d%%.

You may only have one Hymn active at a time.
target:
你学会了三种防御圣诗，以此咏唱对月亮的赞颂：
		暗影圣诗：增加 %d%% 移动速度和 %d%% 施法速度。
		侦测圣诗：潜行侦测强度提高 %d，隐形侦测强度提高 %d，暴击伤害提高 %d%%。
		坚毅圣诗：增加 %d%% 震慑、混乱、致盲抗性。
		你同时只能激活一种圣诗。

source: Do you wish to inspect the pedestal?
Stabilized the Abashed Expanse to maintain it in orbit.
target: 控制次元浮岛使其稳定在轨道上。

source: Bind to middle mouse click (on a target)
target: 绑定至鼠标中键点击目标

source: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
target: 一条成年风暴巨龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

source: The sleeping poison of your Dart Launcher becomes potent enough to ignore immunity, and upon waking the target is slowed by %d%% for 4 turns.
surface_observation: 原文以“of your Dart Launcher”明确限定被强化的睡眠毒素来源，译文遗漏该限定，仅写“睡眠毒素无视免疫”。
target: 睡眠毒素无视免疫，且使目标醒来后减速 %d%% 4 回合。

source: #Target# is protected by a layer of thick leaves.
surface_observation: 原文 thick leaves 指厚厚的树叶，译文“叶刃”加入了原文没有的刃义。

source: The bottom part of Telos' broken staff.
target: 泰勒斯折断法杖的下半部。

source:
You've learned to recover quickly from effects that would disable you. Each turn, you have a %d%% chance to recover from a single stun effect.
		At talent level 2 you may also recover from Blindness, at level 3 Confusion and Pins, and level 4 Disarms and Slows.
		Effects will be cleansed with the priority order Stun > Blind > Confusion > Pin > Disarm > Slow.
		Only one effect may be recovered from each turn, and the chance to recover from an effect scales with your Constitution.
target:
你学会从负面状态中快速恢复。
		每回合你有 %d%% 几率从震慑效果中恢复。
		在等级 2 时，也可以从致盲效果中恢复。
		在等级 3 时，也可以从混乱和定身效果中恢复。
		在等级 4 时，也可以从缴械和减速效果中恢复。
		解除负面状态的优先级是 震慑 > 致盲 > 混乱 > 定身 > 缴械 > 减速
		每回合你只能摆脱 1 种状态。
		受体质影响，恢复概率按比例加成。

source: [Disable the visual effects of your sustains]
Kinetic energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
target: 动能集中在这个灵晶的核心里。

source: Vim represents the amount of life energy/souls you have stolen. Each corruption talent requires some.
target: 活力值代表你窃取的生命能量/灵魂。堕落系技能需要活力值。

source: Stench rises from this rotting abomination. Its brow is adorned with gold, and it moves at you with hatred gleaming in its eyes.
target: 这具腐烂的身躯散发着一股恶臭。它的额头用金子装饰着，它向你逼近，眼中闪烁着仇恨的光芒。

source: Spare me the small talk. I am here to stop you!
target: 我不是来和你们聊天的，我是来阻止你们的！

deep_observation: 补查：组件 mod-tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/class/interface/TooltipsData.lua:239-241（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63），TOOLTIP_MAG 常量，原文与冻结 source 逐字一致。原文第三项是 "the effect of spells and other magic items"，即魔法属性同时提升法术的效果与其他魔法物品的效果；译文「提高其他魔法物品的使用效果」漏掉并列的 spells，少了一项属性收益。漏译还留下悬空的「其他」——译文前文只出现「法术强度」「法术豁免」两项能力名，没有与之并列的「魔法物品」类对象，「其他」失去参照，正是 spells 被删的证据。应作「提高法术和其他魔法物品的效果」。
source:
#GOLD#Magic#LAST#
Magic defines your character's ability to manipulate the magical energy of the world. It increases your Spellpower, Spell Save, and the effect of spells and other magic items.
surface_observation: 原文 the effect of spells and other magic items 同时包含法术和其他魔法物品的效果；译文此处仅保留“其他魔法物品的使用效果”，遗漏法术效果。
target:
#GOLD#魔法#LAST#
魔法属性影响你驾驭魔法能量的能力，提升魔法可以提高你的法术强度，提升法术豁免和提高其他魔法物品的使用效果。
法杖 增加酸性抗性穿透

source:
You attack with mindless brutality. The first critical hit inflicted while rampaging increases the rampage duration by 1.
		Rampage Bonus: Your physical damage increases by %d%%.
		Rampage Bonus: Your Physical Save increases by %d and Mental Save increases by %d.
target:
使你的暴走更加无情，暴走状态下的第一次暴击可延长暴走效果 1 回合。
		暴走加成：你的物理伤害增加 %d%%。
		暴走加成：你的物理豁免增加 %d，精神豁免增加 %d。
